title: Genting Names Tan Kong Han As New CEO.
author: theexchange_asia
body:

title: Genting Malaysia Bhd’s (GENM) loss-making US subsidiary Empire Resorts Inc (ERI) is disposing its non-casino properties in New York state for US$525 million (RM2.2 billion) to eliminate its debt, a...
author: freemalaysiatoday
body:
Genting Malaysia Bhd’s (GENM) loss-making US subsidiary Empire Resorts Inc (ERI) is disposing its non-casino properties in New York state for US$525 million (RM2.2 billion) to eliminate its debt, and purchase land.

GENM said the proposal will “deliver long-term strategic and financial benefits” to ERI as the sale proceeds enables it to fully redeem its US$300 million (RM1.3 billion) bond due in November 2026.

This will make ERI – which has been recording losses for over two decades – debt-free.

title: Moody’s Ratings has placed the issuer ratings of Genting Berhad, Genting Overseas Holdings Limited, and Genting Singapore Limited under review for downgrade, warning that Genting Berhad’s proposed...
author: asiagamingbrief
body:
Moody’s Ratings has placed the issuer ratings of Genting Berhad, Genting Overseas Holdings Limited, and Genting Singapore Limited under review for downgrade, warning that Genting Berhad’s proposed acquisition of the remaining shares in Genting Malaysia Berhad could significantly strain the group’s financial strength.

The review affects Genting Berhad’s Baa2 issuer rating, Genting Overseas Holdings’ Baa2 issuer rating, and Genting Singapore’s A3 issuer rating, all of which previously carried a stable outlook. Moody’s also placed on review the Baa2 backed senior unsecured rating of the notes issued by Genting Overseas Holdings’ subsidiary, GOHL Capital Limited.

The credit review follows Genting Berhad’s announcement of a conditional voluntary cash offer of MYR2.35 ($0.49) per share to acquire the remaining 50.6 percent of Genting Malaysia it does not already own. The deal, valued at up to MYR6.74 billion ($1.6 billion), would be largely funded by as much as MYR6.3 billion ($1.5 billion) in new debt and is expected to close within 60 days, subject to regulatory approval and shareholder acceptance.

title: 1 December 2025, marked a major milestone for the Genting Malaysia Berhad Workers Union as the 14th Collective Agreement (CA-14) was officially concluded, benefiting nearly 10,000 employees with im...
author: rwgentingcareers
body:
1 December 2025, marked a major milestone for the Genting Malaysia Berhad Workers Union as the 14th Collective Agreement (CA-14) was officially concluded, benefiting nearly 10,000 employees with improved compensation and welfare.

✅ 10% salary adjustment under CA-14, highest in the hotel industry since 1974
✅ Raising the starting salary to RM1,800 from the statutory of RM1,700
✅ The agreement was achieved in just 4 meetings over 3 months, the fastest negotiation process in Malaysia’s collective bargaining history

YB Steven Sim Chee Keong, Minister of Human Resources, emphasised: “A collective agreement is a more comprehensive and flexible instrument than minimum wage in safeguarding workers’ welfare. With CA-14 in place, we are ensuring fairer wages, better working conditions, and security. This is collective bargaining in action, protecting livelihoods, honouring dignity, and uplifting our labour force.”

Mr Lee Thiam Kit, Deputy President of Genting Malaysia Berhad, added: “This agreement demonstrates our long-term commitment to our employees’ welfare and career growth. Reinforcing sustainable business success through rooting in the well-being and dedication of our workforce.

title: 受惠于全球休闲与酒店（L&H）业务全面增长，云顶大马（GENM，4715，主板消费股）2026财年首季营业额按年增长10%至28亿6690万令吉，不过，受到纽约赌场商业化营运前期开销拖累，集团由盈转亏。
author: enanyang
body:
受惠于全球休闲与酒店（L&H）业务全面增长，云顶大马（GENM，4715，主板消费股）2026财年首季营业额按年增长10%至28亿6690万令吉，不过，受到纽约赌场商业化营运前期开销拖累，集团由盈转亏。

云顶大马今日公布，截至2026年3月31日首季，集团税前盈利按年下跌77%至4310万令吉。

首季录得净亏2520万令吉，相比上年同期净赚5200万令吉。

云顶大马表示，盈利下滑部分原因是纽约云顶世界（RWNYC）转型为纽约市首个全面商业赌场前，涉及较高前期开销。

大马业务方面，集团休闲与酒店业务营业额按年增长3%至16亿6860万令吉，主要受博彩业务贡献增加带动。

英国及埃及业务方面，营业额按年增长11%至4亿6070万令吉，主要受新收购的Genting Casino Stratford贡献带动。

不过，中东地缘政治紧张局势持续，对当地高端博彩市场构成影响，导致相关业务调整后EBITDA下跌8%至5090万令吉。

美国及巴哈马业务则表现较强，营业额按年大增39%至6亿9440万令吉，主要来自Empire Resorts及旗下业务并表贡献。

展望未来，云顶大马对短期前景维持谨慎态度。中东地缘政治紧张及全球经济不确定性，预计将继续影响旅游及博彩行业表现。

不过，对长期前景仍保持正面，并将继续推动旗下综合度假村升级与设施优化。

title: Maybank has cut its FY26 earnings forecast for Malaysian casino conglomerate Genting Berhad by 11 percent, while raising its FY27 and FY28 earnings estimates by 14 percent and 16 percent, respectiv...
author: asiagamingbrief
body:
Maybank has cut its FY26 earnings forecast for Malaysian casino conglomerate Genting Berhad by 11 percent, while raising its FY27 and FY28 earnings estimates by 14 percent and 16 percent, respectively, largely on the back of expected contributions from table games at Resorts World New York City (RWNYC), according to a research note.

The investment bank maintained its ‘Buy’ recommendation on Genting Berhad but lowered its sum-of-the-parts target price, citing weaker near-term performance across several of the group’s gaming and plantation assets.

Genting Berhad’s first-quarter 2026 core net profit of MYR117.1 million ($29.6 million) represented only 14 percent of Maybank’s full-year estimate. The underperformance was attributed to elevated costs at Resorts World Sentosa (RWS) stemming from its ongoing transformation program, alongside higher marketing, advertising and promotional spending, as well as increased payroll costs at Resorts World Genting (RWG), Genting UK (GENUK) and RWNYC.

Foreign investors approved RM209 billion into Malaysia in 2025.

Kuala Lumpur — RM24.9b

Kedah — RM23.0b

Pulau Pinang — RM18.1b

Sarawak — RM8.9b

Source: MIDA, Approved Private Investments by State 2025 (revised), as of June 2026.

title: Malaysian conglomerate Genting Berhad, the parent company of Genting Malaysia Berhad and Genting Singapore Limited, swung to a second-quarter net loss attributable to shareholders despite stronger...
author: asiagamingbrief
body:
Malaysian conglomerate Genting Berhad, the parent company of Genting Malaysia Berhad and Genting Singapore Limited, swung to a second-quarter net loss attributable to shareholders despite stronger revenue and growth from its US casino operations.

The group recorded a net loss of MYR27.1 million ($6.7 million), compared with a MYR243.5 million profit a year earlier, according to results released on Thursday.

Revenue rose 14 percent year-on-year to MYR7.75 billion ($1.92 billion), while adjusted EBITDA increased 2 percent to MYR2.12 billion ($524.5 million). Profit before tax fell 46 percent to MYR569.6 million ($141 million), partly due to higher finance costs and lower interest income.

Maybank Investment Bank said the results ‘missed our expectations,’ with second-quarter core profit of MYR145.1 million bringing the first-half total to MYR260.6 million, or 35 percent of its full-year estimate.

The brokerage said the earnings shortfall was exacerbated by higher-than-expected net interest expenses. It subsequently reduced its Genting core profit forecasts for 2026 through 2028 by between 20 percent and 26 percent.

author: sinchewdaily
body:
标普全球指出，云顶（GENTING,3182,主板消费产品服务组）部分业务表现未如理想，加上扩张成本不断上升，集团有相当大机会成为“堕落天使”(Fallen Angel），失去投资级评级。

与此同时，继去年取得完整赌场牌照后，云顶计划到2030年为纽约市云顶世界投入55亿美元；另外RWS亦有一项规模相若、涉资50亿美元的扩建计划，令可见将来的资本开支维持在极高水平。

title: Genting Berhad is asking shareholders for about RM1.25 billion, approximately $306 million.
author: igamingtimes
body:
Genting Berhad is asking shareholders for about RM1.25 billion, approximately $306 million.

The proposed rights issue, announced on 9 October, would put RM800 million towards borrowings due within 12 months. Borrowings stood at RM45.25 billion at 30 June.

The Lim family's vehicles, with 45.10% between them, have committed to take up their full entitlements. Underwriting for the rest has not yet been arranged, and the issue price is not fixed.

Maybank Investment Bank cut the stock to sell and said it "cannot rule out more equity fundraising efforts or fewer dividends". The shares fell as much as 17% on Monday.

author: enanyang
body:
云顶大马（GENM，4715，主板消费股）股价跌幅触及马交所规定的卖空价格限制，导致该股的即日卖空（IDSS）暂停，明早8时30分才恢复。

根据马交所今日发布的特别公告，云顶大马最新成交价相较参考价格，下跌超过15%或15仙，触发即日卖空暂停机制。

根据马交所规定，当获准即日卖空的股价跌幅触及相关限制时，即日卖空活动将自动暂停，以避免卖空交易进一步加剧股价波动。

这项措施仅针对云顶大马的即日卖空活动，并不意味着该股全面暂停交易，投资者仍可进行一般股票买卖。

今日闭市时，云顶大马报1.23令吉，跌26仙或17.45%。

author: enanyang
body:
云顶大马（GENM，4715，主板消费股）持续回购股份，累计库存股占已发行股本的比率升至4.56%。

此前云顶（GENTING，3182，主板消费股）已持有该公司73.133%股权，后续回购对75%持股水平及公众持股比例的影响，再受关注。

根据公司公告，云顶大马继9月回购后，于10月12日再以每股1.26至1.27令吉回购股份，全部保留为库存股，并未注销。

根据马交所主板上市规则，上市公司一般须维持至少25%的公众持股比例，库存股不计入相关计算。

若公众持股比例低于10%，马交所有权暂停该股交易，直至公司恢复合规。

云顶全面收购并私有化云顶大马的献议，已于2025年12月1日截止，最终将持股比例提高至73.133%，未达完成私有化所需的90%门槛。

title: A generation of investors grew up believing that Genting Bhd was a cash-generating machine where nothing can go wrong even during the worst of times.
author: theedgemalaysia
body:
A generation of investors grew up believing that Genting Bhd was a cash-generating machine where nothing can go wrong even during the worst of times.

It survived economic turmoil and the pandemic. A stock favoured by ‘mom and pops’ for its regular dividends, the cash from Genting’s only casino in Malaysia was enough to fund its expansion overseas and keep shareholders happy.

From a single casino in Genting Highlands, Pahang, the group, headed by executive chairman Tan Sri Lim Kok Thay, expanded to Singapore, the UK, the US and Bahamas.

The relentless expansion comes with a price.

Genting fell to the lowest point in its history last week when it called for a rights issue to raise RM1.25 billion.

With a cash hoard of more than RM17.6 billion and a business that draws thousands of tourists and high rollers, Genting’s cash call is unfathomable.

Shareholders did not take it lightly, with research analysts calling for a sell on concerns of more cash calls in the future to pay off debts. Consequently, Genting’s share price fell to a 52-week low of RM1.38 last Wednesday before recovering some lost ground.

The company says that there are no further cash calls being planned currently. But investors and analysts have turned negative on Genting.

However, there is also a view that the rights issue is a welcome shift away from Genting’s traditional heavy reliance on debt funding to reduce and refinance its borrowings. It effectively indicates that shareholders are prepared to fork out money to share the deleveraging burden.

However, rating agencies say that Genting needs to do more than a rights issue. A sale of non-core assets is crucial to deleverage.

author: orientaldailynews
body:
云顶大马（GENM，4715，主板消费股）旗下纽约赌场世界度假村纽约市（RWNYC）9月博彩总收入按月持平，分析员预期，年尾计划推出的私人博彩贵宾厅，将成为推动该赌场下一阶段成长的潜在动力。

瑞银分析员在新研究报告中指出，纽约云顶世界在8月31日至10月4日期间，平均每日博彩总收入是约430万美元（约1756万令吉），与8月3日至30日期间的水平基本持平。

从个别业务来看，9月每日角子机博彩收入按月增加约1%，但赌桌博彩收入则下滑约3%。

值得一提的是，纽约云顶世界在9月持续加大促销力度，促销赠额占博彩量的比率从8月约0.5%，升至9月约0.6%。

分析员认为，纽约云顶世界接下来的成长动力，预料将来自计划在今年底推出的私人博彩贵宾厅，该设施有望推动赌场业务进入下一阶段的成长。
